title: NNTP session command loop duplicated between run_plain_session and run_session_io
description: lifecycle.rs contains two ~300-line command dispatch loops with near-identical code: run_plain_session and run_session_io. Every command handled (ARTICLE, XCID, XVERIFY, GROUP, LIST ACTIVE, OVER, AUTHINFO PASS, POST) must be changed in two places. Scenario that triggers the cost: adding a new NNTP command or fixing a handler bug — contributor edits one loop, the other silently diverges. Already visible: STARTTLS logic only appears in run_plain_session. The correct fix is a shared handle_command() fn taking a generic writer, with run_plain_session wrapping it to handle STARTTLS specifically.
